title: B-Roll: U.S. Coast Guard conducts air/sea rescue kit supply drop training during RIMPAC 2026
description: A U.S. Coast Guard C-130 conducts air/sea rescue kit supply drop training as part of Exercise Rim of the Pacific 2026 at Coast Guard Air Station Barbers Point, Hawaii, July 21, 2026. Thirty nations, 30 ships, five submarines, 15 national land forces, more than 206 aircraft and 30,000 personnel are participating in RIMPAC in and around the Hawaiian Islands, June 24 to July 31. The world's largest international maritime exercise, RIMPAC provides a unique training opportunity while fostering and sustaining cooperative relationships among participants critical to ensuring the safety of sea lanes and security on the world's oceans. RIMPAC 2026 is the 30th exercise in the series that began in 1971. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Christopher Nielsen)
credit: U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Christopher Nielsen
pass_reason: rescue-kit drop training: mostly dim cabin shots, one brief drop; no danger
